metas.name: Dhindora
metas.description: It revolves around Bhuvan and his family's everyday lives, when an unexpected purchase leads to a series of events and depicts every common man's larger than life dreams.

metas.name: Bigg Boss
metas.description: Isolated from the outside world, the contestants live together in a house under the live cameras that monitor their every move. They perform various tasks and avoid eviction to be declared a winner.

metas.name: Campus Diaries
metas.description: Campus Diaries is a coming-of-age drama of six students at Excel University. But this one is so-not-your-regular-college-drama because it goes beyond the routine frolic and friendship plots that quintessential youth dramas portray and tackles relevant yet lesser discussed issues like ragging, discrimination based on societal biases, one sided love stories, rampant drug abuse and toxic relationships that mould your personality and ready you to face the real world.

metas.name: Panchayat
metas.description: A comedy-drama, which captures the journey of an engineering graduate Abhishek, who for lack of a better job option joins as secretary of a Panchayat office in a remote village of Uttar Pradesh.

metas.name: The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power
metas.description: Beginning in a time of relative peace, we follow an ensemble cast of characters as they confront the re-emergence of evil to Middle-earth. From the darkest depths of the Misty Mountains, to the majestic forests of Lindon, to the breathtaking island kingdom of Númenor, to the furthest reaches of the map, these kingdoms and characters will carve out legacies that live on long after they are gone.

metas.name: Off Campus
metas.description: A college-set romantic drama chronicling the unexpected love story between a music student and the university's star hockey player, exploring themes of love and the complexities of adulthood through deep friendships and enduring bonds.

metas.name: FROM
metas.description: Unravel the mystery of a nightmarish town in middle America that traps all those who enter. As the unwilling residents fight to keep a sense of normalcy and search for a way out, they must also survive the threats of the surrounding forest – including the terrifying creatures that come out when the sun goes down.

metas.name: The Mentalist
metas.description: Patrick Jane, a former celebrity psychic medium, uses his razor sharp skills of observation and expertise at "reading" people to solve serious crimes with the California Bureau of Investigation.

metas.name: Suzhal - The Vortex
metas.description: A minor girl goes missing in a small town in Tamilnadu and an investigation follows. A sub inspector investigating a missing girl's case in a uncovers some shocking revelations and dirty truths those threaten to shake up the cultural societal fabric.

metas.name: Erotic Stories
metas.description: Erotic Stories is a bold and transgressive anthology series exploring sex and intimacy amongst diverse characters not traditionally seen as sexual leads.

metas.name: The Blue Road
metas.description: Two detectives join forces when brutal murders and cryptic messages surface across borders — but the deadly truth lurks dangerously close.

metas.name: Mirzapur
metas.description: The iron-fisted Akhandanand Tripathi is a millionaire carpet exporter and the mafia don of Mirzapur. His son, Munna, is an unworthy, power-hungry heir who will stop at nothing to inherit his father's legacy. An incident at a wedding procession forces him to cross paths with Ramakant Pandit, an upstanding lawyer, and his sons, Guddu and Bablu. It snowballs into a game of ambition, power and greed that threatens the fabric of this lawless city.

metas.name: MobLand
metas.description: Two mob families clash in a war that threatens to topple empires and lives.

metas.name: Aindham Vedham
metas.description: Whilst in Varanasi for her mother's last rites, Anu is entrusted with an ancient relic by a stranger, destined for a Tamil Nadu priest, which may unveil the secrets of the elusive Fifth Veda.

metas.name: The Body
metas.description: On Halloween night, an all-girls dance squad tumbles into Catholic guilt, unholy desires, and ghostly visions when an initiation goes to hell.

metas.name: Percy Jackson and the Olympians
metas.description: Percy Jackson is on a dangerous quest. Outrunning monsters and outwitting gods, he must journey across America to return Zeus's master bolt and stop an all-out war. With the help of his friends Annabeth and Grover, Percy's journey will lead him closer to the answers he seeks: how to fit into a world where he feels out of place, and who he's destined to be.

metas.name: Blade Runner 2099
metas.description: Takes place fifty years after the events of "Blade Runner 2049."

metas.name: Lo Chudail Chali Sasural
metas.description: Lo Chudail Chali Sasural is a supernatural family sitcom and the Indian adaptation of Bewitched. Urvashi, a chudail longing for a human family, marries Aarav Patel and joins his lively Gujarati joint family. As her magic causes hilarious mishaps, Aarav struggles to protect her secret while her human-hating mother Kamini fuels the chaos. Amid magical mayhem, and family drama, love finds a way.

metas.name: Loki
metas.description: The mercurial villain Loki resumes his role as the God of Mischief in a new series that takes place after the events of “Avengers: Endgame.”

metas.name: Game of Thrones
metas.description: Seven noble families fight for control of the mythical land of Westeros. Friction between the houses leads to full-scale war. All while a very ancient evil awakens in the farthest north. Amidst the war, a neglected military order of misfits, the Night's Watch, is all that stands between the realms of men and icy horrors beyond.
Three intertwined timelines follow the planning and execution of a daring heist in Zurich and its aftermath as an FBI agent pursues a master criminal across Europe.

metas.name: Money Heist
metas.description: To carry out the biggest heist in history, a mysterious man called The Professor recruits a band of eight robbers who have a single characteristic: none of them has anything to lose. Five months of seclusion - memorizing every step, every detail, every probability - culminate in eleven days locked up in the National Coinage and Stamp Factory of Spain, surrounded by police forces and with dozens of hostages in their power, to find out whether their suicide wager will lead to everything or nothing.

metas.name: Black Clover
metas.description: Asta and Yuno were abandoned together at the same church and have been inseparable since. As children, they promised that they would compete against each other to see who would become the next Emperor Magus.

metas.name: Broken But Beautiful
metas.description: Broken is Veer and Sameera's story where their hearts were left broken and damaged after they lost their love. Destiny has brought love in to their lives again, will they give it a second chance?

metas.name: She
metas.description: An undercover assignment to expose a drug ring becomes a timid Mumbai constable's road to empowerment as she realizes her dormant sexuality's potential.

metas.name: Spartacus: House of Ashur
metas.description: In a world where he survived the events of Spartacus, Ashur clawed his way to power, owning the same ludus that once owned him. Allying with a fierce gladiatrix, Ashur ignites a new kind of spectacle that offends the elite.

metas.name: Breaking Bad
metas.description: Walter White, a New Mexico chemistry teacher, is diagnosed with Stage III cancer and given a prognosis of only two years left to live. He becomes filled with a sense of fearlessness and an unrelenting desire to secure his family's financial future at any cost as he enters the dangerous world of drugs and crime.

metas.name: Spartacus
metas.description: The life of Spartacus, the gladiator who led a rebellion against the Romans.

metas.name: Black Sails
metas.description: The pirate adventures of Captain Flint and his men twenty years prior to Robert Louis Stevenson’s classic “Treasure Island.” Flint, the most brilliant and most feared pirate captain of his day, takes on a fast-talking young addition to his crew who goes by the name John Silver. Threatened with extinction on all sides, they fight for the survival of New Providence Island, the most notorious criminal haven of its day – a debauched paradise teeming with pirates, prostitutes, thieves and fortune seekers, a place defined by both its enlightened ideals and its stunning brutality.

metas.name: Love in Disguise
metas.description: Taekang Group's successor, Yoon Yi-jun, is the prime suspect of a shocking murder. To uncover the truth, Kang Jae-hee goes undercover as a male secretary to keep an eye on Yi-jun. The closer they get to what really happened, the closer Yi-jun and Jae-hee become. Will Jae-hee, who is hiding her identity, and Yi-jun, who is hiding a secret, be able to let their true feelings be known to one another?

metas.name: Reacher
metas.description: Jack Reacher, a veteran military police investigator, has just recently entered civilian life. Reacher is a drifter, carrying no phone and the barest of essentials as he travels the country and explores the nation he once served.

metas.name: The Day of the Jackal
metas.description: The Jackal is an elusive assassin who makes his living carrying out hits for the highest fee. He soon meets his match in a tenacious British intelligence officer who tracks him down in a thrilling cat-and-mouse chase across Europe.

metas.name: Weak Hero
metas.description: With the aid of unexpected friends, a gifted but introverted student confronts bullies and violent foes — unaware of how dangerous his world will become.

metas.name: Georgie & Mandy's First Marriage
metas.description: Georgie and Mandy raise their young family in Texas while navigating the challenges of adulthood, parenting, and marriage.

metas.name: The Altruists
metas.description: The story of Sam Bankman-Fried and Caroline Ellison, two hyper-smart, ambitious young idealists who tried to remake the global financial system in the blink of an eye - before they were accused of stealing $8 billion and became Gen Z's own Bonnie & Clyde.

metas.name: Os 12 Signos de Valentina
metas.description: Follows Valentina whose boyfriend cheats on her and she's told their problem was astronomical incompatibility, so she determines to date men of every zodiac sign and share her experiences in a videocast.

metas.name: The Blacklist
metas.description: A new FBI profiler, Elizabeth Keen, has her entire life uprooted when a mysterious criminal, Raymond Reddington, who has eluded capture for decades, turns himself in and insists on speaking only to her.

metas.name: MTV Splitsvilla
metas.description: Ready to witness the ultimate fight between the rules of science and the laws of love? 10 boys, 10 girls and an Oracle who will decide whether or not a couple makes the perfect match! It's time to 'catch your match', Splitsvilla style!

metas.name: Chicago P.D.
metas.description: A riveting police drama about the men and women of the Chicago Police Department's District 21 who put it all on the line to serve and protect their community. District 21 is made up of two distinctly different groups: the uniformed cops who patrol the beat and go head-to-head with the city's street crimes and the Intelligence Unit that combats the city's major offenses - organized crime, drug trafficking, high profile murders and beyond.

metas.name: War
metas.description: Two top London law firms clash over a shocking divorce case that rocks the legal world, with elite attorneys from Cathcarts and Taylor and Byrne battling for supremacy.

metas.name: Pritam and Pedro
metas.description: When a tech-illiterate Goa cop is demoted to the cyber cell, he must team up with a quirky hacker to track down a minister's kidnapped son and win back his old job.

metas.name: House of the Dragon
metas.description: An internal succession war within House Targaryen at the height of its power, 172 years before the birth of Daenerys Targaryen.

metas.name: Musafir Cafe
metas.description: Three travelers lives unexpectedly intertwine. Chander and Sudha share an instant spark. With Preeti, Chander finds steady companionship built on quiet understanding and ease. Which love endures through time, and life's journey?

metas.name: Kaisi Yeh Yaariyan
metas.description: When a small-town girl , Nandini Murty, wins a scholarship to a prestigious Mumbai academy, she clashes with FAB5, the school's elite and arrogant musical clique and it's leader. What begins as a bitter rivalry soon evolves into a passionate, tumultuous romance with the band's enigmatic leader, Manik Malhotra.

metas.name: The Summer I Turned Pretty
metas.description: A love triangle between one girl and two brothers. A story about first love, first heartbreak, and the magic of that one perfect summer.

metas.name: The Law of Beasts
metas.description: When the case of a child serial killer resurfaces after 25 years as an unresolved legal and social problem, two former friends are forced to confront the choices that broke their friendship and shaped their lives.

metas.name: Mithya
metas.description: A tale of two women who are at odds with each other over allegations of plagiarism, which sparks a series of hostilities and shocking revelations spun around a murder for which they both are suspects.

metas.name: Dig
metas.description: Follow four women who work at an archeological dig in Greece. When the team uncovers a long-buried secret with the potential to rewrite history, they find themselves at the center of a high-stakes international conspiracy.

metas.name: Nocturne
metas.description: When a victim of serial killer Jurek Walter turns up alive, detective Jonah Lynn races to find the one person still missing, while his protégé Saga Bauer goes undercover for answers from the killer himself. Based on the bestselling novel by Lars Kepler.

metas.name: Sherlock
metas.description: A modern update finds the famous sleuth and his doctor partner solving crime in 21st century London.
